surface_mechanism: The basmala invokes God by name and frames the surah through repeated mercy.
Praise identifies God as nurturing Lord of all created realms and sovereign owner of the Day of Recompense.
Exclusive worship and exclusive appeal for help turn the divine titles into a direct covenantal relation.
The prayer asks for gentle guidance onto the straight, upright path and identifies that path through bestowed favor.
The closing contrast separates the favored path from the paths characterized by divine wrath and active straying.
